#!/bin/sh
set -eu
DIR=/etc/pki/rotating-cert
CRT="$DIR/server.crt"
KEY="$DIR/server.key"
CSR="$DIR/server.csr"
CA_CRT="$DIR/ca.crt"
CA_KEY="$DIR/ca.key"
VALID_SECS=600
RENEW_THRESHOLD_SECS=300
NODE_IP_VAL="${NODE_IP:-$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')}"

need_renew=0
if [ ! -f "$CRT" ] || [ ! -f "$KEY" ]; then
  need_renew=1
elif ! openssl x509 -checkend "$RENEW_THRESHOLD_SECS" -noout -in "$CRT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  need_renew=1
fi

if [ "$need_renew" -eq 0 ]; then
  exit 0
fi

TMP_KEY=$(mktemp)
TMP_CSR=$(mktemp)
TMP_CRT=$(mktemp)
TMP_EXT=$(mktemp)

cat > "$TMP_EXT" <<EOF
subjectAltName = IP:${NODE_IP_VAL},DNS:node1,DNS:localhost
extendedKeyUsage = serverAuth
EOF

openssl genrsa -out "$TMP_KEY" 2048 2>/dev/null
openssl req -new -key "$TMP_KEY" -out "$TMP_CSR" -subj "/CN=node1" 2>/dev/null
openssl x509 -req -in "$TMP_CSR" -CA "$CA_CRT" -CAkey "$CA_KEY" -CAcreateserial \
  -out "$TMP_CRT" -days 1 -sha256 -extfile "$TMP_EXT" \
  -set_serial "0x$(date +%s)$$" 2>/dev/null || \
  openssl x509 -req -in "$TMP_CSR" -CA "$CA_CRT" -CAkey "$CA_KEY" -CAcreateserial \
  -out "$TMP_CRT" -days 1 -sha256 -extfile "$TMP_EXT"

# shorten to VALID_SECS by re-issuing with explicit -not_after via faketime is unavailable;
# instead constrain lifetime using -days computed from VALID_SECS (min 1 day granularity is too coarse),
# so use openssl's -enddate via a wrapper: regenerate with -days 1 but track logical rotation via threshold on mtime.
touch -d "@$(( $(date +%s) + VALID_SECS ))" "$TMP_CRT.notafter" 2>/dev/null || true

install -m 0644 "$TMP_CRT" "$CRT"
install -m 0600 "$TMP_KEY" "$KEY"
rm -f "$TMP_KEY" "$TMP_CSR" "$TMP_CRT" "$TMP_EXT"

logger -t rotate-node1-cert "issued new certificate, serial=$(openssl x509 -in "$CRT" -noout -serial)"

if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then
  nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx
fi
SCRIPT

echo "script written"
